The BPM analysis, vendored rather than submoduled.

    https://github.com/shaforostoff/foo_rubato
    revision  aa251da2368285abca8c6b32003e5783e20a6a37
    retrieved 2026-09-16

Copied verbatim: bpmcore/, pffft/ and cmake/fft_backend.cmake. Nothing is
patched. If that ever changes, say so here and keep the diff alongside, because
a silent local change to a vendored file is how a build stops matching its
provenance - and here that failure is invisible. rhythm_model.h is 7546 lines of
generated gradient-boosted trees; a corrupted copy does not fail to compile, it
classifies wrongly. The checksums below are the only cheap guard against that.

bpmcore/ is a static library with one public header and no host in it - no
foobar2000, no Windows, no ATL, only the standard library and one FFT reached
through real_fft.h. It is built here for arm64-v8a only, on pffft at single
precision; see ../CMakeLists.txt for why, and ../../../../../LICENSE.md for
pffft's licence.

Re-verify with tools/bpmcheck/run.sh, which also checks these files
still match the foo_rubato tree they came from.
